title: Red panda
description: New biome, new structure, and a new creature
body:
# Important note

Red Panda is a DataPack for version 1.21.10 There is no need to download forge or fabric. Just putting the Biome colors folder in your datapack folder should work for you.

# What is this DataPack?

Red Panda is a DataPack created for Minecraft to add new biomes, structures, and mobs. This DataPack is currently under development, so you can expect future updates. For now you can find the new Chinese biome it contains three new structures: Chinese Bonsai, Chinese Bush, and Chinese Tree. The biome is also home to the red panda, a newly implemented mob that can drop both its meat and its pelt; the meat can be cooked, but the pelt currently has no use.
